items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: The transcript describes an interaction between Charles Edwards Smith and Vladimir Steenevitz at Julius' Bar and Grill. The interviewee (Art Hodes) narrates this event as part of a story about Eddie Condon and Charles Edwards Smith. There is no direct evidence in the text that Art Hodes personally m

ctx.x: And he was also taking a little weight on in his head, where he was getting a little heavy to be around. And after all, we all hung out at Julius' Bar and Grill, which was around the corner of Nick's. And that's where we got our mail, it was our country store, it was our library, this was it. Eddie Condon would wheel his baby up and leave her outside in the buggy and he'd go inside. And this is where we lived, part of the day.

And Charles Edward hung out there, which was getting to be a pain in the ass to Eddie. And Eddie's got a good mind, so he started thinking, what are you going to do about it? So he set this up. And Smith came in one night, and he introduced this guy, who looked like a Russian. Might have looked a little like Kenny Davern with a moustache, and a little hat.
